_note: 學習路徑內容建置第10批 #5／6：分詞構句（現在分詞表主動）（eng.t_adv.special.participial-active，學測級／高階）。現在分詞（-ing）開頭的短句代替同主詞的子句，表示該主詞主動做、常與主句動作同時或緊接：Walking home, I saw…（＝While I was walking home, I saw…）。鐵律＝分詞主詞必與主句主詞一致（否則＝懸垂分詞）。高階防第二正解：用主詞一致性（dangling）＋主動 vs 被動（現在分詞 vs 過去分詞）鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix pta_）。

units.title_zh: 分詞構句：現在分詞表主動／同時（Walking home, I saw…）
units.can_do: 我能用現在分詞（-ing）開頭的分詞構句，代替和主句同主詞的子句，表示該主詞主動做、且常與主句動作同時或緊接發生，並遵守鐵律：分詞的主詞必須和主句主詞一致。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A present participle (-ing) clause can replace a clause with the same subject, showing an action done by that subject: 'Walking home, I saw a rainbow' means 'While I was walking home, I saw a rainbow'.
claims.verification_ref: 現在分詞構句代替同主詞子句、表主詞主動；Walking home, I saw…；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The -ing participle often shows two actions by the same subject happening at the same time, or one just before the other: 'Opening the door, he turned on the lights'.
claims.verification_ref: 現在分詞常表同一主詞同時或緊接的動作；Opening the door, he turned on the lights；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The subject of the participle must be the same as the subject of the main clause; otherwise the sentence is wrong (a dangling participle): correct 'Feeling tired, I went to bed', wrong 'Feeling tired, the bed looked comfortable'.
claims.verification_ref: 分詞主詞必與主句主詞一致，否則＝懸垂分詞；Feeling tired, I went to bed；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The present participle (-ing) shows the subject is doing the action (active); it is not passive, which would use the past participle: 'Smiling, he shook my hand' (he is smiling).
claims.verification_ref: 現在分詞 -ing 表主動（主詞主動做），非被動（被動用過去分詞）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A participle clause starts with a present participle (-ing) and can replace a clause that has the same subject as the main clause, showing an action that subject does. Walking home, I saw a rainbow. (= While I was walking home, I saw a rainbow.)
teach.zh_hint: 分詞構句：用現在分詞（-ing）開頭的短句，可以代替一個和主句『同主詞』的子句，表示那個主詞主動做的動作。Walking home, I saw a rainbow.（＝While I was walking home, I saw a rainbow. 走路回家時，我看到彩虹。）

teach.body: Hearing the good news, she jumped for joy.
teach.zh_hint: 聽到好消息，她高興得跳起來。she 聽到＋she 跳起來，同一主詞、主動。

teach.body: The present participle often shows two actions by the same subject happening at the same time, or one just after the other: Opening the door, he turned on the lights. Also, '-ing' is active (the subject does it), not passive (the passive uses the past participle).
teach.zh_hint: 現在分詞常表示由同一主詞做的兩個動作『同時』或『緊接著』發生：Opening the door, he turned on the lights.（他打開門，接著開燈。）而且 -ing 表主動（主詞自己做），不是被動（被動要用過去分詞）。

teach.body: Smiling warmly, the teacher welcomed the new students.
teach.zh_hint: 老師親切地微笑，歡迎新同學。老師 微笑＋歡迎，同主詞、主動。

teach.body: Golden rule: the subject of the participle must be the same as the subject of the main clause, or the sentence is wrong (this is called a dangling participle). Correct: Feeling tired, I went to bed (I feel tired + I go to bed, both 'I'). Wrong: Feeling tired, the bed looked comfortable (a bed cannot feel tired, so the subjects do not match).
teach.zh_hint: 鐵律：分詞的主詞必須和主句主詞一致，否則句子就錯（叫做『懸垂分詞』）。✅ Feeling tired, I went to bed（我累＋我去睡，主詞都是 I）。❌ Feeling tired, the bed looked comfortable（床不會『感到累』，主詞不一致）。

teach.body: Walking along the beach, we collected many shells.
teach.zh_hint: 我們沿著海灘走，撿了很多貝殼。we 走＋we 撿，主詞一致、主動。

practice.stem: 填入正確的分詞構句開頭：____, I decided to take an umbrella.（看到烏雲，我決定帶把傘。主詞 I 主動看到）

distractor_rationales.Seen the dark clouds: Seen 是過去分詞表被動；這裡 I 是『主動看到』，用現在分詞 Seeing。
distractor_rationales.To see the dark clouds: 不定詞 To see 不表這裡『看到…於是…』的同時主動分詞構句。
distractor_rationales.Saw the dark clouds: Saw 是過去式動詞，不能這樣當分詞構句的開頭。

practice.feedback: 主詞主動做的動作用現在分詞開頭：Seeing the dark clouds, I decided…。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句正確（分詞主詞與主句主詞一致）？
practice.answer: Feeling nervous, I forgot my lines.
options: Feeling nervous, I forgot my lines.
Feeling nervous, my lines were forgotten.
Feeling nervous, the stage seemed huge.
Feeling nervous, it was very hard.

distractor_rationales.Feeling nervous, my lines were forgotten: my lines 不會『感到緊張』；分詞主詞應與主句主詞一致（該是 I）。
the stage 不會感到緊張；主詞不一致＝懸垂分詞。
it 不會感到緊張；主詞不一致。

practice.feedback: 分詞主詞要和主句主詞一致：Feeling nervous, I forgot my lines（都是 I）。

practice.stem: 'Hearing the bell, the students stood up' 是什麼意思？
practice.answer: 學生們聽到鈴聲，接著站起來（主詞都是學生，主動）
options: 學生們聽到鈴聲，接著站起來（主詞都是學生，主動）

distractor_rationales.鈴聲聽到了學生: 分詞主詞是 the students（學生聽到鈴聲），不是鈴聲聽到學生。
distractor_rationales.學生被鈴聲叫醒（被動）: 現在分詞 Hearing 表主動（學生主動聽到），不是被動。
distractor_rationales.學生想要聽鈴聲: Hearing 表『聽到』這個動作，不是『想聽』。

practice.feedback: Hearing the bell＝學生聽到鈴聲（主動）、接著站起來。

practice.stem: 填入正確的分詞構句開頭：____, she said hello.（她拿起電話，說哈囉。主詞 she 主動、同時）

distractor_rationales.Picked up the phone: Picked 是過去式／過去分詞，不作這裡主動、同時的分詞構句開頭；主動同時動作用 -ing。
distractor_rationales.To pick up the phone: 不定詞不表此處同時主動的分詞構句。
distractor_rationales.Pick up the phone: 原形動詞不能當分詞構句的開頭。

practice.feedback: 同主詞、主動同時的動作用現在分詞：Picking up the phone, she said hello。

practice.stem: 'Running to the bus stop, the bus left without me' 為什麼錯？
practice.answer: 分詞 Running 的主詞要和主句一致，但『跑向公車站』的是我、不是 the bus（公車不會跑去公車站）＝懸垂分詞
options: 分詞 Running 的主詞要和主句一致，但『跑向公車站』的是我、不是 the bus（公車不會跑去公車站）＝懸垂分詞
因為 Running 應該改成過去式 Ran

distractor_rationales.因為 Running 應該改成過去式 Ran: 分詞構句本來就用 -ing，不是改時態的問題。
distractor_rationales.因為句子太長: 與長度無關，問題是分詞主詞與主句主詞不一致。
distractor_rationales.因為 bus 是單數: 與單複數無關，問題是分詞主詞與主句主詞不一致。

practice.feedback: 主句主詞是 the bus，但跑的是我＝主詞不一致（懸垂分詞）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Walking into the room, she noticed a letter on the table.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：分詞構句開頭 Walking into the room（現在分詞、主動）有沒有寫對、逗號有沒有漏，主句 she noticed a letter on the table 有沒有寫對（主詞都是 she），句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。分詞構句開頭（-ing 子句）連貫唸、逗號處稍停、主句句尾下收。

lines.intonation: Opening the window 連貫、逗號稍停、I felt the cool morning air 句尾下收

lines.text: Smiling at the crowd, the singer began her song.
lines.intonation: Smiling at the crowd 連貫、逗號稍停、the singer began her song 句尾下收
